open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
open curve25519_dalek

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Montgomery multiplication: for inputs with 52-bit limbs whose product is below
`2^260 * L` (e.g. when either factor is below `L`), the result has 52-bit limbs, is
canonical (`< L`) and satisfies `r * 2^260 ≡ a * b [MOD L]`. -/
@[progress]
theorem montgomery_mul_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ i, i < 5 → (a.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ i, i < 5 → (b.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat a * Scalar52_as_Nat b < 2 ^ 260 * _root_.L) :
    montgomery_mul a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ i, i < 5 → (r.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r * 2 ^ 260 ≡ Scalar52_as_Nat a * Scalar52_as_Nat b [MOD _root_.L] ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r < _root_.L ⦄ := by
  unfold montgomery_mul
  have ha' : ∀ i, i < 5 → (a.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 62 := fun i hi =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (ha i hi) (by norm_num)
  have hb' : ∀ i, i < 5 → (b.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 62 := fun i hi =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (hb i hi) (by norm_num)
  progress as ⟨t, ht, _, ht107⟩
  have hl : ∀ i, i < 9 → (t.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 126 := fun i hi =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (ht107 ha hb i hi) (by norm_num)
  progress as ⟨r, hr, hmod, hlt⟩
  rw [ht] at hmod
  exact ⟨hr, hmod, hlt⟩

/-- Convenience variant: if `b` is canonical (`< L`), the product bound holds automatically. -/
theorem montgomery_mul_spec_right_lt (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ i, i < 5 → (a.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ i, i < 5 → (b.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hbL : Scalar52_as_Nat b < _root_.L) :
    montgomery_mul a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ i, i < 5 → (r.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r * 2 ^ 260 ≡ Scalar52_as_Nat a * Scalar52_as_Nat b [MOD _root_.L] ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r < _root_.L ⦄ := by
  apply montgomery_mul_spec a b ha hb
  have := montgomery_reduce.mr_as_Nat_lt a ha
  calc Scalar52_as_Nat a * Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a * _root_.L :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hbL.le
    _ < 2 ^ 260 * _root_.L := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right this (by unfold _root_.L; norm_num)

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52
